final_scope.xmv12: retained separately but excluded from analysis

frozen_monitor.allowed_abstention: explicit no-alarm policy with original miss penalty; never drop a method or fault
frozen_monitor.run_reset: only at sample1; never at fault onset
frozen_monitor.early_detection: observed postfault detection AND delay <= H; H=15,30,60,120
frozen_monitor.occupancy: number of strict exceedances in samples161..960 divided by800, without latching

secondary: macro median of fault-specific penalized medians

macro_functionals.normal_run_far: mean of17 detector-specific FARs over the same250 normal identities
macro_functionals.mean_or_rate: equal arithmetic mean of17 fault-specific values
macro_functionals.penalized_median_delay: median of17 fault-specific all-run penalized medians; not pooled median and not mean of medians
macro_functionals.conditional_no_prefault: each method/fault excludes its own pre-fault-alarmed runs only from the explicitly conditional denominator
macro_functionals.conditional_zero_denominator: undefined (null); fixed-panel macro null if any of17 fault-specific quantities undefined
macro_functionals.conditional_bootstrap_undefined: retain all replicate identities; a CI is unavailable if any required draw undefined; disclose valid/total, never silently discard faults or draws

uncertainty.draw_schedule: fault-major in ascending registered fault order, then replicate-major, 100-replicate batches, each draw250 int64 indices; one continuous fault RNG; normal RNG separate
uncertainty.method_pairing: same within-fault indices for all methods and all endpoints, including conditional numerators/denominators
uncertainty.far_pairing: one common normal index sequence for all methods and detector rows
uncertainty.paired_contrasts: Adaptive-comparator for higher-is-better detection/occupancy; comparator-Adaptive for FAR/pre-fault alarms/delays

shutdown.primary: all960 released rows retained; record every shutdown, no run/fault/seed replacement or removal
shutdown.supplement_only: per-run observed postfault sample count strictly before first released shutdown sample, alarm before shutdown/horizon, and observed pre-shutdown delay if detected
shutdown.supplement_not_claimed: hypothetical no-shutdown performance, new primary endpoint, rescue or winner criterion
shutdown.normal_shutdown: halt and preserve evidence, do not silently replace normal seed

pre_final_implementation_clarifications_: Explicit PCG64 draw schedule and 100-replicate memory batching; inherited analysis seeds and20000 count unchanged.
Undefined conditional denominators and macro/interval propagation; no partial-panel redefinition.
Normal FAR uses all960 samples; canonical delay0 atsample161 and inclusive horizon comparison match accepted core.
Supplementary shutdown exposure/alarm annotations are separated from unchanged registered primary endpoints.
inherited_role_deviation: O1 accepted only for exact Development state scope, retained verbatim in independent reports; same250 normal reference/scaling/calibration runs not independent
stop_rules: Exactly one new seed bank. Unfavorable results never authorize replacement seeds.
No new method, endpoint, fault exclusion, K, k grid, success criterion, or U5 branch after protocol acceptance.
Before final access, only targeted implementation repair that leaves scientific definitions unchanged and receives independent acceptance is permitted.
After final access, rerun only for exact deterministic recovery from infrastructure failure with identical bytes/hashes; every attempt remains logged.
Negative, abstaining, null, or inconsistent valid results cannot be removed.
